crossRefs.note: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of…
He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for…
“ ‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of…
He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it…
It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.
The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs.…
“ ‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to Yahweh, all that any man gives of such to Yahweh becomes holy.
All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.
Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

translations.web: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated; for it is holy to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: They must not sell or exchange any of it, and they must not transfer this best part of the land, for it is holy to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And they shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first-fruits of the land be alienated; for it is holy unto Jehovah.
